messages:
tess: Thinking of a 'Park Puzzle Picnic' next Saturday 12:3015:00 12 potluck meets mini puzzle hunt + a corner for board games. Family + non-alcoholic friendly. :jigsaw: :sandwich:
marc: love it. is this the west lawn by the fountain?
anya: yes please west lawn. more shade there. can we ask people to bring a blanket and a picnic plate to cut down on disposables?
leo: count me in. i'm happy to hide 8 tiny puzzle clues (w/ QR codes) around the lawn. quick poll: 12:00 or 12:30 start? react with :one: for 12:00, :two: for 12:30.
carmen: :two: (later so families with naps can make it)
tess: ok 12:30 then. i'll make a signup sheet for potluck items (main, sides, drinks, kid snacks). please label allergy info.
marc: i'll bring a tiny folding table for the board game corner and 2-3 two-player games. also can bring extra sun umbrellas.
anya: can security confirm if we need a permit for a small picnic and where we should stash extra coolers? @security
security: @anya for groups under 50 on the lawn we don't need a special permit, but please keep pathways clear. No amplified music outdoors without a permit. You can store coolers near the building loading bay; please coordinate dropoff times.
leo: noted. i'll make clue packets and one family-friendly track and one adult-friendly track for the puzzle hunt. clues will be easy, nothing that needs a ladder. :mag: :feet:
tess: Awesome. Also adding a quick kit request: someone bring wet-wipes, a small first-aid, and a reusable knife for spreading.
carmen: i'll bring wet-wipes + napkins. Also can do a little crafts table for kids (paper, crayons).
marc: bringing two coolers (one for drinks, one for allergy-segregated snacks).
anya: can we have a low-key Slack question for RSVPs: 'bringing kid? yes/no' so we can plan kid activities and chairs.
tess: good idea. i'll add that to the sheet. Also volunteers to help set up at 11:45? react with :hand: if you can help.
leo: :hand: i can help set up clues and peek at the map.
carmen: :hand: i'll do crafts table setup.
marc: :hand: can help with tables + umbrellas.
dev-calendar-bot: Event created: "Park Puzzle Picnic (West Lawn)" 12 Sat Aug 14 12:30-15:00 12 RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.example/e/puzzle-picnic-226789
```
Invite: Park Puzzle Picnic (West Lawn)
When: Sat Aug 14, 12:30-15:00
Where: West Lawn (meet by the fountain)
Notes: Potluck style. Label allergies. Family & non-alcoholic friendly. No amplified music. Volunteers for setup at 11:45. Max 50 people.
```
tess: i'll post the Google signup in 10. please mark if you can chip in $5 for clue-printing & craft supplies, or opt to donate materials.
anya: i can chip in $5.
marc: i'll donate the supplies, no need to chip in.
leo: i'll make the QR clue pages; need a printer though. anyone free to print 12 copies Friday afternoon?
carmen: i can print and drop them at the office Friday.
tess: perfect. i'll post the sign-up and a reminder Thu + day-of. bring sunscreen and a good mood. :sun_with_face: :jigsaw:
